UPDATE ai_pipeline_events
             SET error_message = $2,
                 status = CASE
                     WHEN attempts < max_attempts THEN 'pending'
                     ELSE 'failed'
                 END,
                 scheduled_at = CASE
                     WHEN attempts < max_attempts THEN NOW() + (
                         CASE attempts
                             WHEN 1 THEN INTERVAL '30 seconds'
                             WHEN 2 THEN INTERVAL '2 minutes'
                             ELSE INTERVAL '10 minutes'
                         END
                     )
                     ELSE scheduled_at
                 END
             WHERE id = $1
